# T-4: Integrate plugin presets

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make preset resolver, docs loaders, setup, and upgrade work with plugin preset contributions while preserving base and project-local overrides.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Setup shows base plus plugin repo preset candidates.
- Selecting an uninstalled plugin preset installs/enables its package.
- Existing non-base official type values migrate through senti-presets.
- .senti/presets/<key>/ without preset.json overlays the active registry preset with the same key.

## Implementation Notes
Retain .senti/presets/<key>/ as project-local leaf override. Parent-chain lookup uses core base plus enabled plugin presets, not only src/presets.

## Test Strategy
Setup/upgrade e2e fixtures with official and local path plugin presets.
